nodes.name: PtMn/C Synthesis
nodes.procedure: PtMn/C is prepared by mixing H₂PtCl₆·6H₂O, MnCl₂, and carbon black (i.e., Ketjen Black EC300J), followed by annealing at 1000°C for 6 h (see Experimental section for details).
nodes.source_text: PtMn/C is prepared by mixing H₂PtCl₆·6H₂O, MnCl₂, and carbon black (i.e., Ketjen Black EC300J), followed by annealing at 1000°C for 6 h (see Experimental section for details)

nodes.name: Pt₃Mn/C Synthesis
nodes.procedure: The synthesis approach [mixing H₂PtCl₆·6H₂O, MnCl₂, and carbon black (i.e., Ketjen Black EC300J), followed by annealing at 1000°C for 6 h] can also be used for the preparation of Pt₃Mn IMCs (i.e., Pt₃Mn/C) by precisely controlling the ratio of metal precursors.
nodes.source_text: the synthesis approach can also be used for the preparation of Pt₃Mn IMCs (i.e., Pt₃Mn/C) by precisely controlling the ratio of metal precursors, with more details provided in the Experimental Section

nodes.description: Alkaline HER performance in 1.0 M KOH
nodes.source_text: The alkaline HER performance of PtMn/C and Pt₃Mn/C is assessed by using a standard three-electrode setup in an N₂-purged 1.0 M KOH electrolyte. For comparison, commercial Pt/C is also tested under the same conditions. Linear sweep voltammetry (LSV) polarization curves of each sample after iR-correction are presented in Figure 4a. Specifically, PtMn/C exhibits a low overpotential of only 17 mV at 10 mA cm⁻² (Figure 4b), significantly lower than Pt₃Mn/C (21 mV) and commercial Pt/C (27 mV)... at an overpotential of 50 mV the current densities of PtMn/C, Pt₃Mn/C, and commercial Pt/C are 58, 29, and 23 mA cm⁻²... Tafel slopes of PtMn/C, Pt₃Mn/C, and commercial Pt/C are 31.1, 40.9, and 45.5 mV dec⁻¹... PtMn/C exhibits a notably higher C_dl value of 26.2 mF cm⁻²... the chronoamperometric curve reveals stable operation for 55 h under a constant overpotential of 17 mV

nodes.description: Acidic HER performance in 0.5 M H₂SO₄
nodes.source_text: The HER performance of PtMn/C is also measured under acidic media. The LSV curves of these samples in N₂-purged 0.5 M H₂SO₄ solution... PtMn/C demonstrates a notably lower overpotential of 23 mV at 10 mA cm⁻²... at an overpotential of 50 mV, the current density of PtMn/C reaches 130 mA cm⁻²... Tafel slope analysis reveals significantly enhanced acidic HER kinetics for PtMn/C (16.9 mV dec⁻¹)... at the constant overpotential of 23 mV, PtMn/C maintains a stable current density for 55 h without degradation

nodes.description: AEMWE performance with NiFe LDH anode
nodes.source_text: PtMn/C is integrated into an anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer, demonstrating exceptional performance with a current density of 1 A cm⁻² at only 1.77 V and exhibiting negligible degradation over 500 h of continuous operation... AEMWE system maintains... with 1.0 M KOH electrolyte at a controlled temperature of 60 °C... cell voltage of merely 1.77 V at 1 A cm⁻²... durability test reveals... operation at 1 A cm⁻² for 500 h

nodes.characterization_summary: PtMn/C shows uniform distribution of nanoparticles with average size of 4.3±1.4 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM, Figure 1a) image clearly demonstrates the uniform distribution of PtMn nanoparticles on the carbon substrates, with an average size of only 4.3±1.4 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: PtMn/C reveals distinct diffraction peaks corresponding to the fct PtMn intermetallic phase (P4/mmm, JCPDS No. 97-016-8776).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) pattern of PtMn/C (Figure 1b) reveals distinct diffraction peaks corresponding to the fct PtMn intermetallic phase (P4/mmm, JCPDS No. 97-016-8776).

nodes.characterization_summary: PtMn/C demonstrates specific surface area of 1053.84 m² g⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The prepared PtMn/C demonstrates a porous, rough morphology with a specific surface area of 1053.84 m² g⁻¹, as confirmed by ... Brunauer-Emmett-Teller (BET) analysis (Figure S2, Supporting Information).

nodes.characterization_summary: PtMn/C shows ordered atomic structure along [110] zone axis with Pt atoms surrounded by four Mn atoms in square configuration.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The aberration-corrected HAADF-STEM image of an individual PtMn nanoparticle, taken along the [110] zone axis (Figure 1c), demonstrates that Pt atoms are surrounded by four Mn atoms arranged in a uniform square configuration.

nodes.characterization_summary: PtMn/C shows uniform distribution of Pt and Mn atoms with atomic ratio 53.7:46.3.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Atomic-scale energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) elemental mapping ... The atomic ratio between Pt and Mn is determined to be 53.7:46.3 (Figure S4, Supporting Information).

nodes.characterization_summary: PtMn/C composition aligns with theoretical 1:1 Pt:Mn atomic ratio.
nodes.evidence_snippet: which aligns with the results from inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy (ICP-OES, Table S1, Supporting Information) and the theoretical atomic ratio of 1:1.

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt₃Mn/C shows nanoparticles evenly distributed with average size of 4.9±1.9 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The HAADF-STEM image and the corresponding particle size distribution of Pt₃Mn/C reveal that the nanoparticles, with an average size of 4.9±1.9 nm, are evenly distributed on the carbon black (Figure 2a).

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt₃Mn/C possesses typical fcc Pt₃Mn structure (Pm3̅m, JCPDS No. 97-010-4951).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XRD pattern demonstrates that the prepared Pt₃Mn/C (Figure 2b) possesses a typical fcc Pt₃Mn structure (Pm3̅m, JCPDS No. 97-010-4951).

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt₃Mn/C reveals specific surface area of 1110.02 m² g⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The SEM image (Figure S5, Supporting Information) and BET analysis (Figure S6, Supporting Information) of Pt₃Mn/C reveal a rough and porous morphology, with a specific surface area of 1110.02 m² g⁻¹.

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt₃Mn/C shows homogeneous distribution of Pt and Mn with atomic ratio 75.9:24.1.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The EDS spectrum reveals an atomic ratio between Pt and Mn of 75.9:24.1 in Pt₃Mn/C (Figure S8, Supporting Information), which is consistent with the ICP-OES data.

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt 4f XPS spectra of PtMn/C and Pt₃Mn/C exhibit Pt⁰ metallic states with negative shifts of 0.4 eV and 0.2 eV respectively compared to Pt/C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Pt 4f XPS spectra of PtMn/C, Pt₃Mn/C, and Pt/C catalysts ... exhibit characteristic doublet peaks corresponding to Pt 4f₅/₂ and Pt 4f₇/₂ orbitals, demonstrating that Pt is in metallic states ... Compared to Pt/C, the Pt⁰ 4f peaks of PtMn/C and Pt₃Mn/C exhibit significant negative shifts of 0.4 and 0.2 eV, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: PtMn/C shows I_D/I_G ratio of 1.55 indicating higher defect density in carbon support.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The intensity ratio of D-band to G-band (I_D/I_G) for PtMn/C (1.55) is higher than those of Pt₃Mn/C (1.45), Pt/C (1.21), and carbon black (1.13).

nodes.characterization_summary: Normalized XANES spectra at Pt L₃-edge show PtMn/C has lower white line intensity than Pt foil and Pt₃Mn/C, indicating pronounced charge transfer from Mn to Pt.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The normalized XANES spectra at the Pt L₃-edge for PtMn/C, Pt₃Mn/C, Pt foil, and PtO₂ are shown in Figure 3b. The white line intensity of PtMn/C at the Pt L₃-edge is lower than that of Pt foil and Pt₃Mn/C.

nodes.characterization_summary: PtMn/C shows Pt-Mn bond at 2.35 Å confirming absence of Pt-Pt bonds and isolation of Pt atoms.
nodes.evidence_snippet: PtMn/C exhibits a distinct peak at 2.35 Å corresponding to the Pt-Mn bonds, which is clearly different from the Pt-Pt bonds at 2.52 and 2.85 Å in Pt foil.

properties.description: Extended X-ray Absorption Fine Structure plot

nodes.characterization_summary: Pt₃Mn/C shows Pt-Pt bonds at 2.86 Å and Pt-Mn bonds at 2.44 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: A prominent peak at 2.86 Å of Pt₃Mn/C is attributed to the Pt-Pt bonds ... Moreover, another peak at 2.44 Å exhibits a negative shift compared to the Pt foil (2.52 Å), which can be ascribed to the formation of Pt-Mn bonds.

nodes.characterization_summary: PtMn/C: each Pt atom coordinated to eight Mn atoms; Pt₃Mn/C: each Pt atom coordinated with eight Pt atoms and four Mn atoms.
nodes.evidence_snippet: These results reveal that each Pt atom is coordinated to eight Mn atoms in PtMn/C, while in Pt₃Mn/C, each Pt atom is coordinated with eight Pt atoms and four Mn atoms.

nodes.characterization_summary: PtMn/C shows single peak at 7.4 Å⁻¹ for Pt-Mn bonds; Pt₃Mn/C shows peak at 9.5 Å⁻¹ for Pt-Pt/Mn bonds.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The wavelet-transformed EXAFS (WT-EXAFS) contour plot at the Pt L₃-edge of PtMn/C displays a single peak at 7.4 Å⁻¹, corresponding to the Pt-Mn bonds ... However, the WT-EXAFS contour plot ... of Pt₃Mn/C shows a single peak at 9.5 Å⁻¹, which can be assigned to the Pt-Pt/Mn bonds.
